SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION FROM KEPRQDT RQDT INNER JOIN KEPQTDT QTDT ON (1 = 1 AND QTDT.BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND QTDT.STATUS = 'C' ) WHERE RQDT.BUYER = 'KRDOOS0035' AND RQDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND RQDT.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' AND RQDT.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO LIKE 'DM%' AND 0 = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND ATOB_SEND_FLAG <> 'Y') AND RQDT.RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' ORDER BY RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , TO_NUMBER(RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ) , RQDT.REVISION
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT RQDT.PLANT AS PLANT , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION , RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , RQDT.UNIT_MEASURE , RQDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE , (SELECT MAX(SUBSTR(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(AGENT ||':'|| TO_CHAR(UNIT_PRICE,'FM999,999,999,999,999.00') ||':'|| MAKER_NAME ||':'|| LEAD_TIME, '^||^'),5)) FROM ( SELECT QT.BUYER, QT.QUOTATION_NO, QT.QUOTATION_SEQ, CP.COM_NAME_LOC AGENT, QT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, QT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG, QT.MAKER_NAME, QT.LEAD_TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY QT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE) RK FROM KEPQTDT QT INNER JOIN ICOMCMPY CP ON (1 = 1 AND CP.COM_CODE = QT.AGENT ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND QT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QT.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QT.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND QT.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND QT.STATUS = 'C' AND NVL(QT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0) > 0 ) Z WHERE Z.RK < 4 START WITH Z.RK = 1 CONNECT BY PRIOR Z.RK = ( Z.RK -1 ) ) AS REMARK , DECODE(RQDT.RECV_FLAG,'GD','D','C') STATUS , QTDT.LEAD_TIME , RQDT.ITEM_QTY FROM KEPRQDT RQDT INNER JOIN KEPQTDT QTDT ON (1 = 1 AND QTDT.BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND QTDT.STATUS = 'C' ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RQDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND RQDT.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'Y', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
